name: Axolotl-PM Server
description:
FoxyMC is a brandnew Minecraft Bedrock server currently in beta - join now and be part of our community!

Dive into Apocalypse (currently under maintenance), where you and your friends fight to survive against zombies, explore a custom generated world, experience an immersive story, and complete exciting quests.

Love PvP? Jump into fast-paced game modes like FFA, Knockback FFA, and Sumo.

Want to play only with your friends? Create your own free private server and battle it out whether you're 2 or 10 players!

Join foxymc.de today!
